propositions: The existing checker (policy d37e) enforces mechanism rules (no raw subprocess git) but misses protocol violations where git_adapter mutation primitives are composed outside the atomic transaction boundary

R3 rule must detect calls to git-adapter mutation primitives (add, commit, commit_tree, read_tree, rm_cached, update_ref, write_tree) from outside the sanctioned seam files (git_adapter.py, _ref_lock.py, _ref_lock_push.py) based on module reference binding resolution

R3 fires on receiver-based binding forms: direct imports (from rebar_reconciler import git_adapter) and dynamic-loader patterns, but not on bare method names like set.add or session.commit unless the receiver resolves to a git_adapter module

Durable reasoned inline markers using the existing # raw-git-ok: vocabulary must satisfy all R3 violations; both identified out-of-transaction sites (_commit_binding_store_snapshot and _purge_committed_reconciler_locks) receive markers citing their specific concurrency/boundary justifications

The _purge_committed_reconciler_locks function was extracted to _pass_lock_lifecycle.py after the split to satisfy module-size constraints while preserving the composed primitives and their seam-composition markers

Unit tests must verify R3 does not fire on sanctioned seam files, does not produce false positives on non-git-adapter methods, accepts reasoned markers, and the whole-tree checker exits zero with markers in place
